summary: This is a routine Form 6-K traffic and guidance update from Ryanair Holdings plc, an Irish foreign private issuer, containing monthly passenger statistics and a modest downward revision to FY27 traffic guidance (from 216m to 214m) due to high unhedged winter jet fuel prices. No corporate event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing is operational commentary, not a special-situation disclosure. It does not meet the criteria for any classified category, and therefore the appropriate classification is None.
